name: keep
title: Keep
description: Search, save, and manage links in Keep. Save the current tab, save from the clipboard, mark links read or unread, and track unread count in the menu bar.
author: iannuttall

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your Keep API key. Create one in Keep Settings → API.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Base URL
preferences.description: Optional custom Keep URL for self-hosted installs.

commands.name: search-links
commands.title: Search Links
commands.description: Browse, filter, and manage your saved Keep links
commands.subtitle: Search your Keep installation

commands.name: save-link
commands.title: Save Link
commands.subtitle: Add a link to your Keep library

commands.name: save-clipboard
commands.title: Save Link from Clipboard
commands.description: Save the current clipboard URL to Keep
commands.subtitle: Save clipboard URL to Keep

commands.name: save-tab
commands.title: Save Current Tab
commands.description: Save the active browser tab to Keep
commands.subtitle: Save the active browser tab to Keep

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Unread Links
commands.description: Show unread Keep links in the menu bar
commands.subtitle: Quick access to unread links

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It looks like you are trying to publish this extension to npm.

If you actually want npm publish, remove the prepublishOnly script and run npm publish again.
If you want the Raycast Store, run npm run publish instead.

" && exit 1
